summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K announcing a monthly dividend of $0.175 per share declared on July 30, 2026, payable on September 28, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 31, 2026. Shareholders may receive payment in cash or reinvest in shares via the distribution reinvestment plan. This recurring distribution constitutes a capital return to shareholders but lacks special-situation characteristics such as a special dividend, buyback, or strategic event. The filing is routine and ongoing, with no premium, price, or structural terms disclosed. What to watch: consistency of future monthly distributions.
